Experience with data science, large-scale data initiatives, and implementing platform capabilities across multiple teams is highly preferred

This role focuses on enhancing data discoverability, trustworthiness, and usability through the development of a comprehensive knowledge layer. You will be responsible for evaluating and piloting innovative solutions that bridge the gap between complex data and its users, including AI agents. The position requires a proactive individual who can independently drive initiatives from conception through to large-scale adoption.
